installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# cloudflared install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "${CLOUDFLARED_VERSION}" ] || [ "${CLOUDFLARED_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    URL=https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-${ARCH}
else
    URL=https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/download/${CLOUDFLARED_VERSION}/cloudflared-linux-${ARCH}
fi

echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/cloudflared "${URL}"
chmod 755 /mnt/server/cloudflared
/mnt/server/cloudflared --version

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "cloudflared installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token of a remotely managed tunnel from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard (the long string after --token).

variables.name: Protocol
variables.description: auto, quic or http2. Use http2 if the node blocks outbound UDP 7844.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: debug, info, warn, error or fatal.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: latest or a release tag such as 2026.10.7. Reinstall to update.
